title: Point-indexed component frames with ambient transition units
statement: Let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme] with a finite closed cover i_a: Z_a → Y [def-weil-closed-immersion], discrete pairwise intersections, and invertible modules M_a [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write T for the union of intersections of distinct component images. There are opens U_p indexed by points p of Y, units g_pq on U_p ∩ U_q, and free generators f_ap of M_a on i_a^{-1}(U_p) [def-sc-local-free-generator], such that the U_p cover Y, g_pp=1, distinct U_p and U_q overlap only outside T, and f_ap on an overlap equals the image of g_pq times f_aq. The conclusion contains no ambient module and asserts no cocycle identities.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NE, direct existence proof, local trivializations and overlap transition functions, before gluing the ambient line bundle

proof.text: The union T of pairwise component intersections is a finite union of closed discrete sets. Closedness comes from the closed immersions. Use Mathlib isClosed_iUnion_of_finite and IsDiscrete.iUnion (including the proof-indexed unions) to prove closedness and discreteness of T.

At a point y and for each component a, if y is in its image choose its unique preimage and a local free generator, using the proved invertibility bridge and exists_isFreeGenerator. The inducing topology of the closed immersion lifts this trivializing open to an ambient open containing y. If y is outside the component image, use its open complement; the inverse image is empty and zero is a free generator, as proved from the empty-cover sheaf axiom. Finitely intersect these ambient opens with an initial neighborhood D and restrict the frames.

For y in T choose D whose intersection with T is {y}, using Mathlib isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen. For y outside T take D to be the complement of T. Apply the simultaneous trivialization from the preceding step and choose U_y with all the component frames. Each point is in U_y, so these opens cover. If x belongs to T and to both U_p and U_q, the two isolating properties give x=p and x=q; therefore distinct opens overlap off T.

On a diagonal overlap take the unit 1. On an overlap of distinct opens, restrict both component frames and use the proved IsFreeGenerator.exists_unit_smul_eq to obtain their unique frame-change unit c_a. The reduced-cover section bijection lifts the tuple of values c_a and the tuple of inverse values to ambient sections s and t. Since the component ring maps send s*t to one, injectivity gives s*t=1. Commutativity gives t*s=1, so (s,t) defines the desired ambient unit. Its images are the component coefficients, which proves every frame relation. Choose these units and return the cover and frames. No data is chosen from a merely existential unproved theorem: the only holed input used for lifting is a bijection, which determines each lifted section uniquely.

proof_origin.place: Varieties Lemma 09NE checked in the Stacks web edition https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09NE; point-indexed refinement, empty-open argument and lifted inverse construction by A3

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedCover_frame_transitions
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible] :
    let T : Set Y := ⋃ a : ι, ⋃ b : ι, ⋃ (_ : b ≠ a),
      Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)
    ∃ (U : Y → Y.Opens) (g : ∀ p q : Y, Γ(Y, U p ⊓ U q)ˣ)
      (f : ∀ (a : ι) (p : Y), Γ(M a, (i a) ⁻¹ᵁ U p)),
      (⨆ p, U p = ⊤) ∧
      (∀ p, g p p = 1) ∧
      (∀ p q : Y, p ≠ q → (U p ⊓ U q : Set Y) ⊆ Tᶜ) ∧
      (∀ a p, IsFreeGenerator (f a p)) ∧
      (∀ a p q,
        (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE ((i a).preimage_mono inf_le_left)).op (f a p) =
          (i a).app (U p ⊓ U q) (g p q).val •
            (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE ((i a).preimage_mono inf_le_right)).op
              (f a q))
